---
title: "The Option Type for Absent Values"
---

# The Option Type for Absent Values
Rust has no `null` or `nil`. Absent values are explicitly represented with `Option<T>`:

```rust
fn find_desk(number: u32) -> Option<&'static str> {
    if number == 1 {
        Some("Front Reception")
    } else {
        None
    }
}

fn main() {
    let desk = find_desk(1);
    println!("Found desk: {:?}", desk.unwrap_or("Unassigned"));
}
```
